enrichment.headline: Adds $29,884 to Silicon Valley Paving's Oakland Tech asphalt contract to repair damaged pavement
enrichment.summary: This change order pays Silicon Valley Paving to repair about 3,520 square feet of asphalt near the boys' gym at Oakland Technical High School. A painting contractor's equipment damaged the new asphalt, and the painting contractor has agreed to a charge back. The contract's maximum price rises from $559,716 to $589,599.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.presenter: Deputy Chief, Facilities Planning and Management
items.title: Change Order No. 2, Agreement Between Owner and Contractor – Silicon Valley Paving, Inc. – Oakland Technical High School Asphalt Replacement Project – Buildings and Grounds Department

enrichment.headline: Pays ACC Environmental $50,623 to monitor asbestos removal at the Cole Campus administration building
enrichment.summary: ACC Environmental Consultants will inspect and sample suspected asbestos-containing materials. It will also oversee the removal and monitor the air while asbestos-containing pipe and boiler insulation is removed from the main building at the Central Administration at Cole Campus. The work is scheduled to run from February 27, 2025 to June 30, 2025.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.presenter: Deputy Chief, Facilities Planning and Management
items.title: General Services Agreement – ACC Environmental Consultants, Inc. – Central Administration at Cole Campus - Division of Facilities Planning and Management

enrichment.headline: Extends the state CAL FIRE living schoolyards planning grant at 15 campuses to May 31, 2025
enrichment.summary: This amendment extends the district's grant from the California Department of Forestry and Fire Protection (CAL FIRE) from March 30, 2025 to May 31, 2025. The grant, listed at $2,798,074.20, supports planning to turn 15 campuses into living schoolyards, including community design input, soil testing and a geotechnical report. The text does not state any added money.

vendor.name: California Department of Forestry and Fire Protection (CAL FIRE)

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Amendment No. 1, Grant Award - State of California - Department of Forestry and Fire Protection (CAL FIRE) - Oakland Schoolyards Planning Project - Chief Systems and Services Officer

enrichment.headline: Ratifies $32,000 for Philanthropic Ventures Foundation's living schoolyard coaching and training
enrichment.summary: Philanthropic Ventures Foundation will run two six-hour fellowship professional development sessions and five team coaching sessions to support living schoolyard education. It will also provide research-based curriculum materials and coaching between sessions. The agreement runs from October 1, 2024 to June 30, 2025, and the board is approving it after the start date.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Services Agreement 2024-2025 - Philanthropic Ventures Foundation - Facilities Planning and Management Department

enrichment.headline: Approves Personnel Report No. 2425-0006 from the Talent/Human Resources Department
enrichment.summary: The board approves a regular personnel report from the district's Talent/Human Resources Department. The agenda text does not describe the individual hires, changes or amounts in the report.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Personnel Report No. 2425-0006 - Talent/Human Resources Department

enrichment.headline: Names three teachers as Oakland Unified's 2025-2026 Teachers of the Year
enrichment.summary: This resolution designates three teachers, collectively and individually, as Oakland Unified School District's Teachers of the Year for 2025-2026. The agenda text lists no dollar amount.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Designation/Selection – Maria De La Fuente-Moreno, Alyssa Kronick, and Krista Toumi - Collectively and Individually, as an Oakland Unified School District 2025-2026 Teacher of the Year - Talent/Human Resources Department

enrichment.headline: Ratifies $18,172 for Moving Forward Education to train after-school staff on social and literacy skills
enrichment.summary: Moving Forward Education will provide professional learning, technical assistance and system-building help to expanded learning leaders, line staff and interns. The goal is to support Oakland students' social, emotional and literacy skills. The agreement runs from January 10, 2025 to June 16, 2025, and the board is approving it after the start date.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Services Agreement 2024-2025 - Moving Forward Education - Community Schools and Student Services Department

enrichment.headline: Ratifies $12,300 for East Bay Art Therapy group sessions at Manzanita SEED Elementary
enrichment.summary: East Bay Art Therapy will provide creative arts therapy group services tailored to the school's needs at Manzanita SEED Elementary School. The agreement runs from December 1, 2024 to May 30, 2025, and the board is approving it after the start date.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Services Agreement 2024-2025 - East Bay Art Therapy - Manzanita SEED Elementary School

enrichment.headline: Ratifies up to $5,110 for a family liaison at Oakland High School for 2024-2025
enrichment.summary: An individual contractor will serve as a family liaison at Oakland High School. The liaison connects families to school resources, directs them to the right person on campus, and does outreach about school events and activities. The agreement runs from August 7, 2024 to May 30, 2025, and the board is approving it after the start date.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Services Agreement 2024-2025 - Michelle Gonzalez - Oakland High School

enrichment.headline: Pays Growing Together - Bay Area up to $10,000 for garden education at Ralph J. Bunche Academy
enrichment.summary: Growing Together - Bay Area will partner with the hospitality, tourism and recreation pathway elective teachers at Ralph J. Bunche Academy. Students will work in the garden weekly on project-based learning tied to academic standards. The agreement runs from February 3, 2025 to May 30, 2025.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Services Agreement 2024-2025 - Growing Together - Bay Area - Ralph J. Bunche Academy

enrichment.headline: Ratifies $3,200 for Berkeley Repertory Theatre theater workshops at Oakland International High
enrichment.summary: Berkeley Repertory Theatre will lead theater arts workshops at Oakland International High School. The workshops align with Common Core standards and help students build critical thinking, creativity and communication skills. The agreement runs from April 7, 2025 to April 14, 2025.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Services Agreement 2024-2025 - Berkeley Repertory Theatre - Oakland International High School

enrichment.headline: Pays Oakland Kids First up to $57,000 for leadership and school culture programs at Fremont High
enrichment.summary: Oakland Kids First will support a leadership class and school culture and climate activities at Fremont High School. It will also run the cultural currency program and the student store, host lunchtime and after-school events and restorative justice circles, and provide student incentives. The agreement runs from August 12, 2024 to June 30, 2025.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Services Agreement 2024-2025 - Oakland Kids First - Fremont High School

enrichment.headline: Ratifies $11,000 for mindfulness workshops and videos for credit recovery staff and students
enrichment.summary: Unconditional Word, LLC, doing business as Jordan Benn, will run monthly virtual mindfulness workshops for credit recovery teachers and support staff. It will also create 14 pre-recorded mindfulness videos for staff and students and give virtual coaching to the credit recovery team. The agreement runs from January 6, 2025 to June 30, 2025, and the board is approving it after the start date.

vendor.name: Unconditional Word, LLC dba Jordan Benn

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Services Agreement 2024-2025 - Unconditional Word, LLC dba Jordan Benn - OPSR Counseling Department

enrichment.headline: Pays East Bay Consortium up to $20,000 for college advisors for newcomer seniors at RISE Academy
enrichment.summary: East Bay Consortium will provide two college student advisors for seniors in the newcomer RISE Academy during the Spring 2025 semester. The advisors help students apply for financial aid and postsecondary programs and graduate with clear next steps. The agreement runs from January 1, 2025 to June 30, 2025.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Services Agreement 2024-2025 - East Bay Consortium - Linked Learning Department

enrichment.headline: Ratifies $6,000 more for Kids Cooking For Life classes at Franklin Elementary, raising the cap to $12,000
enrichment.summary: This amendment adds more cooking classes for 4th and 5th grade students at Franklin Elementary School. The maximum payment rises from $6,000 to $12,000. The term is unchanged, September 16, 2024 to May 23, 2025, and the board is approving the change after the fact.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Amendment No. 1, Services Agreement 2024-2025 - Kids Cooking For Life - Franklin Elementary School

enrichment.summary: Playworks will provide a trained Site Specialist at Manzanita SEED Elementary School.
